instruction: Apply bold formatting to the bottom textbox text on slide 1.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold formatting to the bottom textbox on slide 1. Getter extracts bold state from all runs of the bottom textbox (sorted by vertical position). Metric checks if all runs are bold.

scoring_breakdown.bold_match: 1.0 - Bottom textbox text has bold formatting applied
